startersHint: A starter sets the design, the heading and the wording. The preview below shows a sample name until you add your own list.
title: Heading
reasonHint: This line is printed under every name. A person's own line can replace it (see the list below).
namesHint: Type or paste one name on each line, for example from a spreadsheet column. To give one person a different line, write the name, a | sign and the line: Riya Sharma | for winning first place.
namesPlaceholder:
Riya Sharma
Aman Verma
Priya Singh
countNone: No names yet, so the preview shows a sample name.
tooMany: The most you can make at once is {max} in a PDF and {zipMax} in a zip. Split your list into parts.
signHint: Leave a name empty to keep just the line, so it can be signed by hand after printing.

outputs.zip: A zip with one PDF for each person

outputHint: A zip is best when you will send each person their own certificate on WhatsApp.
keepOpen: Keep this page open until it is done.
failed: The certificates could not be made. Try fewer names.
notSelectable: The name and the wording are saved as pictures so Hindi and other scripts look right. The text in the PDF cannot be selected or searched.
notSaved: Your names are never saved or uploaded. Only the wording and design are remembered on this device.
